notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard joined-federate MOM HLAobjectInstancesRegistered count. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM declarations, HLAinteger32BE, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, logical-time configuration when applicable, and application object class and attribute names. It verifies direct ordinary MOM object reflection at zero, one, and two successful registrations, reliable RTI-originated reflection metadata, standard handle/name lookups, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, diagnostics, periodic timers, or wall-clock assumptions.
